scripts.cf:deploy: bash scripts/check-worker.sh && bash scripts/build-site.sh && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.cf:preview: bash scripts/check-worker.sh && bash scripts/build-site.sh && npx wrangler versions upload
scripts.format:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/wfhub-api/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml
scripts.catalogue:export: cargo run --release --manifest-path apps/wfhub-api/Cargo.toml --bin export-catalogue -- apps/wfhub-api/.sources/catalogue apps/wfhub-api/data/catalogue
scripts.worldstate:export: cargo run --release --manifest-path apps/wfhub-api/Cargo.toml --bin export-worldstate -- apps/wfhub-api/.sources/worldstate apps/wfhub-api/.sources/catalogue apps/wfhub-api/data/worldstate
scripts.test: cargo test --release --manifest-path apps/wfhub-api/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml
